body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal H_{\beta,D}(m)\) and \(y\ge1\), \[\min_{\pi\in\Pi_m}S_P^{\pi}(y)=\frac1m\left\{\sum_{x=1}^mS_{x0}(y)+\sum_{x\in B_P(y)}\Delta_x(y)\right\}.\] Thus the entire control-plus-selected-contrast sum, including every selected negative contrast, is normalized by \(m^{-1}\). As an arithmetic corollary, when \(m=2\), this becomes \(\{S_{10}(y)+S_{20}(y)+\min(0,\Delta_1(y),\Delta_2(y))\}/2\); if \(\Delta_1(y)\le0\) and \(\Delta_2(y)=0\), it equals \(\{S_{11}(y)+S_{20}(y)\}/2\).
body.justification: The corrected common normalization is the exact finite-dimensional reduction; its two-cell corollary checks the smallest nontrivial capacity problem without creating a separate solve target.
body.gap: XiaZhangKong2026 uses successive classification for fixed quantile regimes; the pointwise top-capacity representation here must remain valid under generalized inversion and changing tail dominance.
body.consumer: It supplies a polynomial-time sorting and scalar-inversion implementation for the tail-cost workflow of OsamaZachariahStoica2020.
